name: Agnes M. McAvoy

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Joseph S. Jones by Rev. P. J. Colligan; Luzerne docket no. 71238 (licence 26 Dec 1914). Agnes, 30, at home, b./res. Plymouth.

bioAdditions: Her 1914 marriage docket names her parents William (deceased, born New York) and Catharine Murphy (living in Plymouth, born Schuylkill Co.) (S1). Children (FS): Edward (1916-1995), Joseph (b. 1918) and Kathryn Ann (1919-1995, m. Henry P. Derwin) (S2).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Marriage docket names parents William McAvoy and Catharine Murphy.
